reviews.x: I needed to find a way to cut back spending $80 a month at the nail salon. This kit had beautiful nail colors and everything I needed to make my nails pretty. I would purchase it again.

I was happy with everything when I first got it. I can use all the small bits and pieces that came with the lamp. And the lamp worked fine the first 6 times I used it. Then suddenly it stopped working. It will not turn on no matter what I do. I have even tried screwing it apart and take a look inside, but nothing works. And I haven't dropped the lamp or anything, I have been very careful with it. Such a shame because I was really loving it in the beginning. But I cannot use the gel lack without

Absolutely perfect. Works exactly as I had hoped. The light is perfect and if you genuinely want to do your own gel or dip nails I would highly recommend it. I have been using it for 2 months now and everything is still working perfectly.
Bought it for my wife, both her and my daughter, loved it!
Absolutely worth it! I work in healthcare so constant hand sanitizer and hand washing and this gel has withheld perfectly! I’m amazed.

Im in love with this set of at home shellac products , they really get the job done .. you would get exactly what shows in the picture.. the bottles are MINi that was the only thing I wasn't aware of but for the price im ok with it .. ALL items are GOOD quality !!!! Really recommend it !!
Perfect! Works great very professional colors are beautiful. Lap works perfect I just put 2 min and gel is dry no sticky or tacky . Love it ! Def recomend it ! So worth the money

I had this item sitting in my cart for a long time. I finally placed my order because the kit would basically pay for itself after one use. I was very impressed with everything. The colors are beautiful and last. Will definitely be ordering more colors! So happy with my purchase and my only regret is not buying it sooner!
Amazing! Was in a hurry but still able to give myself a quick pedicure! And wow! They look like I️ just left the salon! Will update with photos soon

reviews.t: Needs better glue for the tips.
reviews.x: This was nice but after 2 days I lost 2 tips.  Wasn't easy to remove the rest, but overall was good for the event I put them on for.

I was a little skeptical to get this kit since it seemed a little too affordable. I loved the bright colors and hoped for the best. I am so glad I went for it! The light is big enough to fit your whole hand under, so there's no need to do your thumb separately. I have been very impressed with the quality of this kit. I did my nails a week ago, and look how the polish has held up!

for what you spend getting your nails done this entire kit came with so many extras it's unbelievable for $50 you can't go wrong I love love love this product and the UV lamp is awesome it works just like a high-quality so-called nail salon lamp and the gel polish performs the same as well

I loved it for the first week before the lamp stopped working. Completely dead won’t turn on. The gel polish it brings won’t last 2 weeks, more like 1 week at the most. But now the lamp doesn’t work so I can’t use anything...

Love it definitely the best investment I have done. I had never time to go to the beauty salon to make my nails done, and also here where I live is extremely expesive. I can do them by myself on a Sunday night while watching tv on my pijama without wasting so much money. The colors are great and  you can have them perfect for at least two weeks, after that they start to fall.
Great product, good price for full starter set. Lovely vibrant colors! I couldn’t be happier with this purchase to keep my nails manicured during quarantine.
Thankful that I can do my own mani/pedi and not be concerned with an infection.

Tried this kit for the first time the other night and I am SO impressed! I followed all the steps (pushed back my cuticles, used a pH bonder -purchased separately-, a base coat, used UV light 60-90 seconds between each coat, etc). I work in a hospital and so far, my manicure has held up quite well despite using hand sanitizer a LOT throughout the day. I was especially careful to not get any polish on my skin because I know from experience they will lift easily.  I can’t wait to keep using it. Al

The kit itself had a ton of stuff in it but my nails started chipping and peeling up after 1-2 days. It was hell on them. I was constantly redoing them. I decided to upgrade to better base and top coat. It was still happening. Upgraded to nicer polishes, still happening. Finally purchased a different brand of lamp and used both original polishes and they are staying much longer, so I’m definitely chalking it up to the light in the lamp since I tried changing each thing one at a time!!

Update: The gel doesn't last longer than regular nail polish and the lamp feels like its giving me cancer of the hand. Used 1 time and my nails peeled off in about 12 hours. UGH!  Previous Don’t know how long it lasts yet or if it’s easy to remove but looks very good today!  The heat lamp gets way too hot! Kind of scary like a tanning booth. If it breaks I’ll get a different brand but it’s already paid for itself did my nails last night. Feels like it’s tanning your hands.

Okay, for starters if you’ve been on the fence about buying a nail kit since we can’t get our manis and sets during the rona. Fear not! This kit has it all, I purchased nail tips separately so I could do long nails and I’m so happy I did. Everytime I do my nails I have people asking where I got them done and when I tell them I did them myself they are always shocked. Buy this nail kit ladies, you won’t regret it! 💅🏻

reviews.t: don't buy this! nails will peel off after a few hours and company is unreliable
reviews.x: I bought this in October thinking i would treat myself to a new gel it.. The polish peels off within hours..I have been doing my own gel nails for months! I use Gelish and have great results. I left a review previously the company contacted me and told me if i deleted my review they would give me a full refund... i deleted and never received any refund...don't waste your time!

After being stuck in quarantine with my bare nails, I started daydreaming about having my nails done. And since salons were still closed I purchased this starter kit! I would recommend it 100000% the lamp works great, the colors are super cute, and the gel lasts long! it also comes with everything you need to clean your nails giving you that salon-fresh look!

Y’all.. coming from someone who’s been doing their own nails for a few years now, this kit is amazing!! My light was going out on my old one. I was a little skeptical about buying this brand lamp just because of the unfamiliarity, but it works perfect! I’m familiar with the polish brand (love) and it comes with so many extra little trinkets! BUY THIS KIT! 😘

I just got this but I already love everything it comes with for $50. I applied it to my nail so we will see how it goes but super easy to apply and come with jewels, design tape, white tips and more. Getting a gel mani can be so pricey so I am happy it came with so much. Also love the nail colors.

I am very impressed!  The only reason I'm giving 4 stars is because I just did my nails with this kit today... I'm reserving the final star to see how well this wears.  Soo far this looks and feels as good as what I've had done in a salon. If this wears well it will have paid for itself in one use

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the kit as a great value that saves money versus salon visits.
Many customers love the beautiful, vibrant colors included in the set.
Several reviewers report the UV/LED lamp stopped working after a short time.
Multiple customers say the kit works well and performs like a professional salon result.
A few reviewers note issues with durability, such as tips falling off or polish not lasting long.
